verdict.rationale: Rive's docs say the editor can create vector graphics, and a community user confirms a pen tool and basic shapes exist. That same user calls the drawing toolset limited ('pen and a couple of basic shapes'), and no evidence covers path editing, boolean operations or precise alignment. missing for 10: documented path/node editing, boolean operations, precise alignment/distribution tools, independent corroboration of professional-grade vector tooling

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work
